title: The developer tools that will define the next decade

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The next decade will be defined by "the" — specifically, the rise of standardized, open protocols that enable seamless integration across platforms.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Developer" tools will define the decade because they drive innovation — tools like Rust, WebAssembly, and AI-assisted coding are already changing how software is built.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open protocols like gRPC and GraphQL provide the backbone for scalable, interoperable systems — that’s the foundation of the future, not just a trend.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without developer-centric tools, even the best protocols remain inaccessible. GitHub Copilot and VS Code extensions are what make development fast, efficient, and inclusive.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future is written by developers — tools that empower them will shape the next decade, not abstract protocols.
